name: WebGL Voxelization via Triangle Splitting and Instancing
definition: A method to calculate the distance field of a mesh in real-time on WebGL by converting mesh triangles into small points (particles) that fit within voxels, using instancing to handle adjacent voxels and depth testing to simulate atomic minimum-distance updates.
summary: WebGL Voxelization via Triangle Splitting and Instancing calculates real-time distance fields by splitting triangles and using instancing with depth testing, avoiding WebGL's lack of compute shaders and atomic operations.
